evaluation_scope.decision_target: Allow one sticky live cohort in one app on one placement only after shadow evidence clears every frozen floor and cap.

metric_bindings.label: Eligible population / sample floor
metric_bindings.observability_rule: Always observable from the growth shadow report.

metric_bindings.label: Attribution completeness floor
metric_bindings.source_ref: shadow_placed candidates with all required attribution fields / shadow_placed candidates
metric_bindings.observability_rule: Requires at least one shadow_placed candidate.

metric_bindings.label: Minimum shadow CTR
metric_bindings.source_ref: distinct pilot_shadow_click_logged source_outbound_id / distinct pilot_shadow_impression_logged source_outbound_id
metric_bindings.observability_rule: Requires imported shadow impression and click evidence keyed by source_outbound_id.

metric_bindings.label: Minimum attributed destination activation
metric_bindings.source_ref: distinct recovery_guardrail_applied source_outbound_id / distinct pilot_shadow_click_logged source_outbound_id
metric_bindings.observability_rule: Requires shadow click evidence and attributed destination activation receipts keyed by source_outbound_id.

metric_bindings.label: Minimum retained activation window
metric_bindings.source_ref: distinct pilot_activation_retained source_outbound_id within retained_activation_window_days / distinct recovery_guardrail_applied source_outbound_id
metric_bindings.observability_rule: Requires retained activation evidence keyed by source_outbound_id after attributed destination activation.

metric_bindings.label: Maximum duplicate exposure rate
metric_bindings.source_ref: duplicate pilot_shadow_impression_logged events / total pilot_shadow_impression_logged events
metric_bindings.observability_rule: Requires shadow impression evidence keyed by source_outbound_id.

metric_bindings.label: Maximum dismissal / complaint rate
metric_bindings.source_ref: distinct pilot_placement_dismissed or pilot_support_complaint_opened source_outbound_id / distinct pilot_shadow_impression_logged source_outbound_id
metric_bindings.observability_rule: Requires placement feedback evidence keyed by source_outbound_id.

thresholds.description: Do not open a live cohort until the shadow lane shows at least one narrow-pilot-sized eligible sample.
Every shadow-placed candidate must carry the frozen attribution join fields before live exposure is allowed.
The narrow pilot requires positive shadow click-through evidence before a sticky live cohort opens.
Attributed destination activation must stay positive before the lane graduates from shadow-only.
Activated members must retain through the frozen post-activation window before widening is considered.
Any suppression bypass blocks live rollout because it means the guardrail lane is leaking unsafe placements.
Duplicate shadow exposures must stay rare before a sticky pilot is allowed.
Negative placement feedback must remain below the frozen cap before or during any live pilot.

widen_only_if: shadow_click_through_rate stays above the frozen floor for two consecutive evaluation windows
attributed_destination_activation_rate stays above the frozen floor for two consecutive evaluation windows
retained_activation_rate stays above the frozen floor for two consecutive evaluation windows
dismissal_complaint_rate stays at or below the frozen cap during the pilot

stay_shadow_conditions: Any threshold with blocking_mode stay_shadow is unobservable or below its frozen floor.
Any growth-pack or dashboard-pack acceptance check fails.
The warehouse does not contain keyed impression, click, activation, retention, and feedback evidence for the placement lineage.
The live cohort would require more than one app, one surface, or one placement.
rollback_conditions: Any downstream activation or retention metric falls below its frozen floor after the live cohort opens.

criteria: consumer_of_pack_versions includes the pinned growth, metrics, and dashboard packs.
evaluation_scope placement_id and surface_id match the growth pack placement contract.
No live cohort is allowed until owner truth evaluates this pack as pass.
pilot_rollout_policy max_live_apps, max_live_surfaces, and max_live_placements all remain 1.
sticky_rollout_percentage stays narrow and cohort assignment remains sticky on member_id + week_start_date.
max_live_cohort_members stays at or below the frozen cap.
shadow_click_through_rate, attributed_destination_activation_rate, retained_activation_rate, and dismissal_complaint_rate are all observable before live cohort approval.
Each observable metric is keyed by source_outbound_id so the growth lineage stays replay-safe.
